messages:
Lina Park: Quick syncWe got a support ticket: tenant sees 'v1 deprecated' badge but all live traffic shows as v2 in quota graphs. They think we switched their config. Can we make console semantics clearer?
Toms Ruiz: TLDR: configured_route != active_route during capacity fallbacks. Console only showed configured_route. Small fix: add 'active_route' to /route-status and show both.
Eileen Zhou: Also quota attribution must follow active_route. Right now quota-service reads control-plane route. Change order: quota picks router-decision header if present.
Lina Park: UX copy idea: top-of-page pills: "Configured: v1 (deprecated)" and "Active: v2 (since 2026-03-20 11:02 UTC)" w/ a tiny "why" link to routing trace. Non-alarming language.
Toms Ruiz: Router will emit header: X-Route-Decision: variant=v2;id=dec-abc123;ver=2. Quota daemon will prefer that header. We'll version header so older services ignore it.
Eileen Zhou: Telemetry: emit metric tenant.active_vs_configured_pct and add alert when mismatch > 5% sustained for 30m. Also sample decision traces (1% overall, 100% for low-volume tenants that enable preview).
infra-bot: Note: ticket PLAT-4217 created. Router v5 canary w/ decision header scheduled for beta tomorrow.
Lina Park: Policy matter: per-tenant fallback enum {ALLOW, WARN, DENY}. Default WARN: show banner and fallback. DENY => 503 when configured not available. Add SDK docs to avoid automatic client-side upgrades.
Toms Ruiz: Impl plan: 1) add active_route in route-status API, 2) add header in router canary, 3) prefer header in quota service behind flag, 4) console UI to show both pills + modal on "why" link, 5) alarms + runbook.
Eileen Zhou: For billing: recommend adding a "billing-equiv" opt-in flag and a short-term banner that shows predicted invoice delta; defer invoice math changes until finance signs off.
Lina Park: Thanks I'll own copy and runbook. Toms -> router header + quota change. Eileen -> metrics + sampling. Revisit after canary.
